All changes are complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Changes in `codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs`

Added `request_permissions_tool_enabled: bool` as the new last parameter (appended after `exec_permission_approvals_enabled`) to all three permission-instruction functions, and threaded it through:

1. **`DeveloperInstructions::from(approval_policy, exec_policy, exec_permission_approvals_enabled, request_permissions_tool_enabled)`** — the leaf constructor. The new flag is bound with `let _ =` since the disabled path must produce byte-for-byte identical output (no true-path behavior is defined by this task).
2. **`from_policy(...)`** — the method taking `exec_policy: &Policy`, `cwd: &Path`, etc. (the one exercised by the `permissions_message_includes_writable_roots` integration test). It now passes the flag through to `from_permissions_with_network`.
3. **`from_permissions_with_network(...)`** — passes the flag through to `from`.

Because the flag is only ever consumed via `let _ =` and never alters `text`, **output is unchanged when `request_permissions_tool_enabled` is false.**

## Call sites updated (so `codex-core` compiles)

- `codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs:3380` — passes `turn_context.features.enabled(Feature::RequestPermissionsTool)`.
- `codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs:43` — passes `next.features.enabled(Feature::RequestPermissionsTool)`.

Both mirror the existing `Feature::ExecPermissionApprovals` argument, per the requirement to pass the `RequestPermissionsTool` feature flag value.

## Inline unit tests in `models.rs`

Updated the four inline unit-test call sites (in the `#[cfg(test)]` module of this source file — not the `tests/` directory) to append the new argument so the protocol crate's test target still compiles. I left the `tests/` directory untouched.
